svg.title: Turki Faisal
svg.desc: Turki Faisal. I build apps for mobile, the web and the Mac. App developer · Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. A city skyline where each of 52 towers is one week of GitHub contributions; the tallest, 940 contributions, is the week of Nov 7, 2026.

g.text: The skyline is my GitHub activity: one tower per week, Nov 2025 – Nov 2026
